description: The command that installs a PS3 package, or a folder of them, into RPCS3, and what the install leaves: every package it takes, where each goes, the boot file of a game's folder — read the way RPCS3 d5213de6 installs.

vectors.name: package-install-rpcs3-installs-a-folder-of-packages
vectors.rationale: RetroDECK runs RPCS3 for ps3: handed the game's folder, rpcs3 --headless --installpkg takes every file whose path contains .pkg, sorted by name — the licence package into user 00000001's exdata, the game into dev_hdd0/game/<the header's title id>, its executable as USRDIR/EBOOT.BIN — and exits 0 whatever came of it (rpcs3.cpp:1146-1187; main_window.cpp:818-936; unpkg.cpp:860-919 at d5213de6).

    <path>%ROMPATH%/ps3</path>

    <command label="RPCS3 Shortcut (Standalone)">%ENABLESHORTCUTS% %EMULATOR_OS-SHELL% %ROM%</command>
    <command label="RPCS3 Game Serial (Standalone)">%EMULATOR_RPCS3% --no-gui %RPCS3_GAMEID%:%INJECT%=%BASENAME%.ps3</command>
    <command label="RPCS3 Directory (Standalone)">%EMULATOR_RPCS3% --no-gui %ROM%</command>
    <command label="RPCS3 ISO (Standalone)">%EMULATOR_RPCS3% --no-gui %ROM%</command>
  </system>
</systemList>

vectors.name: package-install-rpcs3-installs-one-package
vectors.rationale: Handed one package, the install takes that file alone; its program is the RPCS3 entry's own.

vectors.name: package-install-licences-go-to-the-installers-account
vectors.rationale: A .rap beside the packages is copied into user 00000001's exdata first; with a second account on the drive, the user RPCS3 reads licences for at launch may be another, which atlas does not read: package-licence-account.
